description: Two bags of engineered grass. Mellow, hungry, harmless-ish.

events.text: [trip]Time slows to a comfortable crawl. There is nowhere you need to be.[/trip]
[trip]A thought drifts by, profound and important, and you completely fail to catch it.[/trip]
[trip]You become deeply, urgently aware that you would demolish an entire vending machine of snacks.[/trip]
[trip]The plush heaviness thins out into a pleasant, dopey haze.[/trip]

phases.end_message: The mellow lifts. You are mostly just hungry now.
phases.peak_message: A soft heaviness settles over you. The edges of the room go plush.

effects.take_line: You pack a bowl of {name} and burn it down.

withdrawal.message: You cannot get to sleep, and the sleep you do get is loud and detailed and full of people.

stages.easing: Four hours in one piece. You come out of it sour, and rested enough to notice you are sour.
stages.onset: The plush comes off the room. Every surface is exactly as hard as it actually is.
stages.peak: Three in the morning, awake, sweating through a shirt, and the ninety minutes you got were in colour and full of people you owe things to.
stages.rising: You are not hungry at a time you are normally extremely hungry, and food smells like a job.
stages.tail: Sleeping through. Eating properly. The dreams are still busier than they were before you started.

name: dreamsmoke
